svg.title: Left, schematic: low-rank LoRA learning curves leave the full fine-tuning line when the adapter runs out of capacity. Right: final loss on Llama-3.1-8B/Tulu3 falls from 0.587 at rank 1 to about 0.55 at ranks 64-512; full fine-tuning 0.548.
